title: Benchmarking Machine Reading Comprehension: A Psychological Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation of how machine reading comprehension models exploit unintended stylistic classifiers, dataset-specific patterns, and word-association biases, proposing adversarial filtering and shortcut-proof question design as mitigation.
Theoretical proposal to assess model fairness and robustness to social biases as part of the 'consequential aspect' of construct validity, measured via a comprehensive scoring rubric.
